intro: Government and critical infrastructure sectors were the primary focus of 16 CISA-tagged articles published between April 12 and April 30, 2026. The coverage highlighted threat actors GRU, Interlock, and LummaC2, alongside critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2024-57726, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-1708, CVE-2024-20662, and CVE-2024-21412. The severity mix comprised 13 high and 3 critical incidents, with impacts spanning the United States, North America, Europe, and other global regions.
